name: video-dialog
title: Video dialog
description: Watch the video in a dialog: a poster with a play button opens a player at the video's proportions that starts on open, stops on close and returns focus.
docs: title is required: it is the dialog's title and names the player and the iframe. Give sources (best first, with their type) or an embedUrl. The player exists only while the dialog is open: it starts when the browser allows sound, otherwise muted with a hint to turn it on, and it is paused the moment the dialog closes. An embedUrl is shown in a titled iframe that is created after the dialog opens; only http, https and your own paths are used, and your Content-Security-Policy must allow the host in frame-src. trigger is any single element: leave it out for a poster button, pass null to open it yourself with open. The open animation is skipped under reduced motion.
